citations.quote: When I'm telling you, have anyone set you down in your mind, you see yourself sitting down with someone and having a conversation.

observation.text: The speaker uses questions like 'Has anyone kind of set you down?' to prompt visual imagery of a focused conversation, steering the client's reflection on their past interactions with agents.

citations.quote: it's the same as I'm trying to teach you a brain surgery on the phone

observation.text: The speaker uses an analogy comparing complex information overload to attempting to teach brain surgery over the phone, emphasizing the ineffectiveness of such methods.

citations.quote: the only way he can answer his questions that you help him understand he has, is to be on a meeting with you.

goal.text: Help the client understand they need the meeting to gain essential information and insight they currently lack.

citations.quote: Transition into scheduling a presentation because I have to give you this meet. Because if you don't know how to schedule a presentation, are you using the Mr. client, we need to have a Zoom call so I can show you X and Y and Z

summary.text: Transition into scheduling a presentation with the client is important. Rather than stating the need for a Zoom call, frame it so the client understands it's to address what they lack in knowledge and expertise.

citations.quote: Even if he have been in Dubai or never been in Dubai or living in Dubai, it's realistically doesn't matter. Understand you have been in Dubai and potentially have your own perspective on the market.

How confident do you feel about being able to identify the best opportunities, the best investment, not based on, you know, what the other agents are telling you about that seven, fifteen or guaranteed ROI, but on the actual market data, the sales and rental transaction for the past, you know, like three, four years in that area

summary.text: Understanding a client's perspective, regardless of their familiarity with Dubai, is key to identifying and presenting investment opportunities based on actual market data, sales, rental transactions, and government infrastructure plans.

citations.quote: because it's way too much information, right? It's the same as I'm trying to teach you a brain surgery on the phone like how effective that going to be.

Why I'm saying it this way? And why, one more time I'm telling you, you have to memorize my brain surgery technique till the point that you will be able to create your own. I am directing your thought process.
